01 · The Idea

One platform, built around three words.

RUN

Everything your team needs to operate.

  • POS — take orders and process payments quickly
  • QR ordering — customers browse and order from their phones
  • Kitchen — orders sent straight to the kitchen, preparation tracked
  • Tables — manage tables and floor operations
  • Payments — M-Pesa, cash and transaction tracking

UNDERSTAND

Stop guessing what's happening in your restaurant.

  • What sells — and when it sells
  • What customers spend
  • Which menu items perform
  • How your restaurant is performing
  • And ultimately: what is actually profitable

GROW

Turn customers into repeat customers.

  • Customer profiles
  • Loyalty points & rewards
  • Promotions
  • AI recommendations
  • Customer re-engagement
  • WhatsApp marketing

02 · The System

See it working

Real screens from the platform.

Restaurant Dashboard — Today’s sales, orders and activity at a glance.
QR Digital Menu — Customers scan, browse categories and order from their phone.
Customer Ordering — Cart, special instructions and payment choice.
Point of Sale (POS) — Fast order entry and payment handling for cashiers.
Kitchen Display System — Orders reach the kitchen instantly with prep tracking.
Tables & Floor Plan — Live table status across the restaurant.
M-Pesa & Payments — M-Pesa, cash and transaction records.
Analytics — Revenue, top dishes and menu performance.
Customers (CRM) — Customer profiles, spend and segments.
AI — Restaurant Manager — AI answers questions and produces a daily briefing.
